children: Stock-specific action remained in focus on Dalal Street on September 21, with investors reacting to corporate developments and brokerages view.

Refex Industries share price gained 4% after company bagged a contract worth Rs 160 crore for lifting 10 lakh metric tonnes (MT) of pond ash and fly ash under the RCR (Road-cum-Rail) mode from a public sector undertaking in Madhya Pradesh.

Shares of G R Infraprojects advanced more than 3% has received a letter from the National Highways Authority of India declaring September 7 as the appointed date for the Rs 4,262.78-crore project for the construction of the Agra-Gwalior Greenfield road.

Coforge share price jumped 4% after company announced expanded capabilities to help automotive lenders, fleet operators and remarketing organisations transform vehicle inspections into AI-powered lifecycle intelligence, enabling faster and more informed business decisions throughout the remarketing process.

Share price of Emmvee Photovoltaic Power surged more than 6% as Jefferies maintained ‘Buy’ rating on Emmvee Photovoltaic Power with a target price of ₹440 per share. The brokerage expects 70 GWdc demand in FY27, with DCR demand exceeding supply, while DCR economics remain attractive. Module and cell capacity is expanding by 6 GW each, with the company targeting 9 GW of ingot-wafer integration by FY29-30.
On the sectoral front, the IT index declined nearly 1%, while the pharma index gained 1.2%. FMCG, private bank, consumer durables and realty indices rose around 0.5% each.
The broader market remained under pressure, with the Nifty Midcap 100 index falling 0.2%, while the Nifty Smallcap 100 index traded flat.
Market breadth on the BSE was positive, with 1,954 shares advancing, 1,462 declining and 198 unchanged.

title: Price Action: Emmvee Photovoltaic surges 6% as Jefferies maintains ‘Buy’; Refex Industries gains 4% on contract win
